summary: Retest of iteration_53 HIGH items. Unit tests: 17/17 pass (8 new in test_phone_veto_grid_desc.py: QC phone veto, _fix_prompt phone text, FIX_SYSTEM alignment, _retry_extra phone drop, _skin, _paste_hand refusal on a synthetic case, grid desc names). I ran 4 REAL renders, one after another. (1) POSE SINGLE, hotel mirror selfie + white tee, 77s: QC attempt 1 = 'smartphone still visible' (veto worked) -> the fix pass removed it -> QC passed. PASS: the phone is gone, the hand hangs relaxed with 5 fingers, the watch stays on the correct wrist, the tee is untucked, the jacket is removed, and the wallet/hat hand and background are preserved. A flat pad band is still visible at the top. (2) FREE RETRY mani_viso, 107s: NO PHONE (HIGH #1 fixed for the phone itself). BUT the result is a different photo: a new hallway background (no mirror, a different sculpture), a different hat (brown fedora instead of a straw conical hat), the hat moved to the other hand, a different pose, the bag strap is lost, different trousers and shoes. head_lock then pastes the original head oval (with the old hotel background) onto the new scene, which gives a clearly visible elliptical 'halo' patch around the head. QC flagged 'halo' on attempts 1 and 2, and the fixes could not remove it because finalize re-pastes the head oval each time. (3) POSE GRID, white tee + denim shorts, Unsplash street, 107s: PASS. The garment desc 'light-blue distressed denim shorts with cuffed hems...' was used as the name. The shorts are applied, the jacket is removed, the tee is untucked after a fix pass, and the pose, face, shoes and background are kept. Minor: the background pedestrians and necklace were removed. (4) AVATAR regression, 41s: QC passed on the 1st try and both hands were pasted (shift 5,-16 seam 22.7; 6,-41 seam 7.5). THE RECTANGULAR SKIN PATCH IS STILL THERE on the white tee below the phone hand, with hard horizontal and vertical edges. Cleanup: 2 tryons were deleted via the API and the outfit via mongo (DELETE /api/outfits/{id} still returns 404).

critical.issue: The skin gate is ineffective. YCrCb range Cr 133-173 / Cb 77-127 classifies the white tee in warm/dim indoor light as skin: measured on the result, the shaded tee is 66% skin and the tee below the patch is 30%. Both 'both-skin' and the 0.6 ratio test therefore pass, and the original bare chest is pasted over the tee. QC did not flag it this time. The patch also has HARD RECTANGULAR EDGES, because the ellipse mask (radii 0.47, blur sigma 0.12*min side) is still about 0.4 at the box border midpoints, so the cut at the box border is visible. Fix: (a) feather the mask to 0 at the box border (smaller radii ~0.38, or multiply by a border falloff); (b) gate on similarity to the original rather than on skin colour: paste only where |canvas - out| is small (the model kept that pixel as skin), or reject when the area under the hand differs strongly in colour from the original skin (low chroma/high luminance = fabric); (c) consider a stricter seam threshold for large shifts (|dy|>30).

The phone stayed removed, but the retry generated a NEW SCENE: different background, hat and pose (the hat moved to the other hand), lost bag strap, different trousers and shoes. The head_lock head oval with the original background pasted onto it then creates a visible elliptical halo. QC flagged the halo twice and the fix could not repair it, because finalize re-pastes the oval each time. The best candidate was still returned. Fix ideas: detect a background mismatch around the head oval in finalize (ring diff like the hand seam check) and either skip the head paste or reject/regenerate; make QC veto 'background changed / halo' in pose mode; strengthen the mani_viso retry text with 'same background/scene/objects as IMAGE 1'.

minor.issue: best_score starts at -1 and the comparison is '>', so if every attempt has a phone (all -1), the first (phone) image is still returned. There is no hard guarantee; a final extra fix or an error could be considered.
A flat pad band is still left at the top of the pose single result (beige band above the ceiling).
Small scene edits: the background pedestrians and the necklace were removed.
QC/classifier model is 'gemini-3.8-flash'. It works (the calls succeed), but verify that this is the intended model name.

action_items: HIGH: Avatar hand paste: replace or augment the YCrCb skin gate (it matches warm-lit white fabric) with an original-vs-result similarity mask, and feather the mask to 0 at the box border to remove the rectangular edges
HIGH: Pose retry: prevent scene drift (background/objects/pose) and skip or reject the head-oval paste when the surrounding background no longer matches (visible halo)
Trim the remaining top pad band; optionally add DELETE /api/outfits/{id}
critical_code_review_comments: _qc phone veto and _fix_prompt(phone=True) are correct and verified live: QC caught the phone and the fix pass removed it.
_retry_extra .replace string matches RETRY_REASONS['mani_viso'] exactly, so the phone grip text is dropped when posed.
_garment_info caches only when the category is valid; a failed classification returns {} and the slot falls back to the generic name.
_paste_hand: m*both with a dilated/blurred skin mask is fine in principle, but the skin colour model is too permissive and the base ellipse is not zero at the box border.
server.py is >3400 lines; it should be split.

success_rate.backend: Unit 17/17. Real renders 4/4 completed; 2/4 met the requirements (pose single, pose grid). The pose retry has no phone but changed the scene and has a halo; the avatar still has the skin patch.

seed_data_creation: None persistent. 2 tryons were deleted via the API and 1 outfit via mongo.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Same scripts as iteration 53 (export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL first): run_pose_retry_render.py single | retry <id> mani_viso ; run_pose_phone_render.py grid | avatar. Inputs are in /tmp (phone_selfie.jpg, pose_hip.jpg, tee.jpg, shorts.jpg, av.jpg). Side-by-sides are in iteration_54_imgs (s54_1 single, s54_2 retry, s54_3 grid, s54_4/4z avatar patch). The avatar patch area in g3_result (1536x2050) is about x845-1053, y699-774. Do not edit backend files while a render runs (the WatchFiles reload kills the job).
rca of the issue: Avatar patch: _skin(out) returns 255 for the shaded white tee (mean RGB ~147,136,130 -> 66% skin), so the 'both skin' mask covers the tee and the original chest pixels are blended in. The ellipse mask is ~0.4 at the box edge, which creates the straight rectangular borders. Retry halo: the image model re-imagined the scene, and head_lock.finalize pastes the original head oval (including its old background) unconditionally, so the QC fix loop cannot remove the halo.
